g.text: Read this way: where every cause of brain injury is counted, cycling is about 6 % (two sources). It is a larger part of narrower counts: about a fifth of road users

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: hospitalized with a brain injury around Montréal, and the largest single activity among sport and recreation brain injuries admitted to hospital.

g.text: Sources: Ontario emergency visits, Fu and colleagues, 2016 (PMID 26760779). Montreal General Hospital, Dagher and colleagues, 2016 (PMID 26786638); the share is this review’s division of the two published counts.
